spans.s:
√tuj 'urge, thrust'
present: [7.] tuñjánti tuñjáte (3p.) etc. -- [1.] túñjamāna -- [6.] tujánt tujete -- [1.] tojati 
perfect: tūtujāná tū́tujāna tutujyāt tutoja 
[aorist: atojīt tojiṣyati tojitā ]
verbal: tujáse -túje tujáye? 
secondary: passive: tujyáte etc. -- causative: tujáyant etc. 
derivatives: túj tújya RV. túji RV. tuñjá RV. túgra RV. túgvan RV. tuṅga? E.+ tūtuji RV. 
This and the preceding are probably two forms of the same root. For the connection of meaning, compare the roots su, sū.
